nodes.description: Private owner address; privileged role for init, _mints, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transfer/transferFrom/batchSend/_mints.
Public nested mapping of allowances read and written by approve and transferFrom.
Address whitelisted in ensure() and settable by owner via setTradeAddress.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Whitelist mapping set in _mints and read in ensure.
Minimum sale amount configured by init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount configured by init and enforced in condition.
Sale count limit configured by init and enforced in condition.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address used as a whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist gate that resolves the Uniswap pair and otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom with unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only payable function performing an arbitrary delegatecall.
Privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and grants canSale whitelist.
Owner-only initializer of sale limits _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only payable batch distribution with unchecked total computation and loop additions.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using CREATE2 hashing.
Payable constructor setting metadata, supply, owner and an infinite UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowances and privileged checks.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executed with this contract's storage context.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop.
Parameter _from of transferFrom/ensure carrying the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom carrying the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom carrying the transferred amount.
Parameter saleNum of init setting the _saleNum limit.
Parameter token of init setting the _minSale limit.
Parameter maxToken of init setting the _maxSale limit.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the destination address array.
Parameter _value of batchSend, the per-recipient amount.
Parameter a of delegate, the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate, the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
Parameter spender of _mints, the balance overwritten and whitelisted.
Parameter addedValue of _mints, the new raw balance.
Local _UNI in ensure holding the computed Uniswap pair address.
Local total in batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length.
Loop index i in batchSend.
Loop-local _to destination in batchSend.
Sorted token0 local in pairFor.
Sorted token1 local in pairFor.

edges.reason: owner is initialized from msg.sender in the constructor, making the privileged role caller-controlled.
msg.sender is used as the transfer sender inside transfer.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping and is checked against _from in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller address.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, so caller identity gates arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints grants minting when msg.sender is owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing the whitelist address.
constructor consumes msg.sender to set owner and initial balances.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before moving balances.
transferFrom passes _from, _to and _value as arguments into ensure.
ensure falls back to condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted accounts.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address by calling pairFor.
ensure stores the pairFor result in the local _UNI.
ensure whitelists _from/_to when they equal the owner.
ensure whitelists _from when it equals the mutable tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists _from when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure compares _from against the hardcoded UNI router constant.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after the transfer.
_value flows into the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction.
_value flows into the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value addition.
_value flows into the unchecked allowance decrement.
Parameter _value directly supplies the amount subtracted from balanceOf[_from].
Parameter _value directly supplies the amount added to balanceOf[_to].
Parameter _value directly supplies the allowance decrement amount.
Parameter _from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
Parameter _from is used by ensure for owner, pair and whitelist comparisons.
Parameter _to is compared against the owner inside ensure.
Parameter _value is forwarded by ensure into condition.
Parameter _from is read from _onSaleNum inside condition.
Parameter _value is bounded by _minSale and _maxSale inside condition.
condition reads the _onSaleNum counter for the sender.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
condition checks the _saleNum limit and its zero-config shortcut.
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall operation.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata payload.
Parameter a supplies the arbitrary address that receives the delegatecall.
Parameter b supplies the arbitrary calldata executed in this storage context.
The arbitrary delegatecall executes external code that can re-enter transferFrom while balances are still unsettled.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the raw addedValue amount.
_mints grants canSale[spender] = true, bypassing ensure thereafter.
Parameter spender is the account whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted.
Parameter addedValue supplies the new raw balance in _mints.
init writes the _minSale limit from token.
init writes the _maxSale limit from maxToken.
init writes the _saleNum limit from saleNum.
Parameter saleNum sets the _saleNum counter limit.
Parameter token sets the _minSale amount.
Parameter maxToken sets the _maxSale amount.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
batchSend computes the local total from _value and _tos.length.
batchSend iterates using the loop counter i.
batchSend reads each destination address into the loop-local _to.
Parameter _tos provides the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
Parameter _value is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
_value * _tos.length may overflow because it is computed without SafeMath.
The possibly-overflowed total flows into balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend performs an unchecked subtraction of total from the owner balance.
batchSend performs unchecked per-recipient additions inside the loop.
Parameter _value flows into each unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value.
The loop-local _to is the recipient credited in each batchSend iteration.
approve writes the allowance mapping for the spender.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure.
pairFor assigns the sorted lower address to local token0.
pairFor assigns the sorted higher address to local token1.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
constructor sets an infinite allowance for the UNI router address.
constructor scales _supply by 10**decimals to set totalSupply without overflow checks.

normalization_plan.reason: parameter _from only exists to feed transferFrom/ensure and can be folded into the function node.
parameter _to only flows into transferFrom balance updates and can be folded into the function node.
parameter _value only feeds the transferFrom arithmetic and can be folded into the function node.
parameter saleNum is a transient initializer input merged into init.
parameter token is a transient initializer input merged into init.
parameter maxToken is a transient initializer input merged into init.
parameter _tos is only iterated inside batchSend and merges into it.
parameter _value of batchSend is only used inside that function.
parameter a exists solely as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
parameter b exists solely as the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
parameter spender is only used to index balanceOf and canSale in _mints.
parameter addedValue is only used as the new balance in _mints.
local _UNI is a transient result of pairFor consumed immediately by ensure.
local total is a transient product that directly feeds the unchecked batchSend subtraction.
loop counter i has no independent meaning outside batchSend.
loop-local _to is only the recipient of the unchecked balance addition.
local token0 is a transient sort artifact inside pairFor.
local token1 is a transient sort artifact inside pairFor.
